arcana_status: 20 registered/runnable in FX Lab per branch status. Candidate fusion/redesign labels are historical report acceptance labels; do not override Creator decision without latest review. Gameplay binding not implied.

currency.note: Six material kinds as agreed. Costs per cast and per batch remain calibrated target values, not canon numbers.

qa_principle: Every event has source actor/target/location/tick and immutable event ID, gameplay authority commits first, VFX presentation may reset/scrub without re-granting damage/loot. Critical world effects persist independently of visual duration.
